title: Unite the People
description: The supplied remastered artwork connects Colin Levy’s name with Iley Dread and carries the Kings of Kings crown identity.

title: Lover’s Holiday
description: The single artwork and accompanying release-showcase material document Lover’s Holiday, from Colin Levy, also known as Iley Dread.

title: Miracle

title: Unleashed
description: The supplied Unleashed campaign artwork is complemented by record-release showcase flyers for Montréal and Toronto in April and May 2016.
